citations.assessment: The internal Mari bar Rahel dossier explicitly lists Rabbah among the sons. Bava Batra identifies Mari as Issur’s son. The distinct Kiddushin episode identifies two other named sons.
Aha the Elder’s dossier discusses the sibling names and the uncertainty of the reported Rava name in Yuhasin.

holds.reason: Kiddushin 65b names Mar Zutra and Rav Adda the Elder as the sons appearing before Rav Ashi. The specific appearance by Rabbah remains qualified.
The literal juxtaposition permits the existing reading, but the Aha dossier lists Aha, Mar Zutra and Rava separately and expressly qualifies Rava. No alias is admitted.

notes.text: The Mari dossier records the alleged kinship. The possible appearance before Rav Ashi and the relationship of the Aha and Rava names remain open.
